The '''Bacia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] regions.<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Bacian blood hornet]]s.<ref name="HonorAmongThieves" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bacia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
